person.id: Full name of the person, including any titles or suffixes (e.g., Dr. Jane Doe, John Smith Jr.), used as the unique identifier for this individual (required)
person.about: A concise summary that captures the person’s professional background, key achievements, and their significance in their field or to the organization, written in 1-2 sentences (required)
person.occupation: The primary role or position the person holds, such as their academic title (e.g., Professor, Researcher) or professional role (e.g., CEO, Engineer) (optional)

organization.id: The full, official name of the organization with which the person is affiliated (e.g., Stanford University, Google Inc.), serving as a link to the 'organization' entity (required if organization is included)
The full, official name of the organization (e.g., Massachusetts Institute of Technology, United Nations), used as the unique identifier for this entity (required)
organization.about: A brief summary that includes the organization’s mission, a short history, and its scope of work or influence, written in 1-2 sentences (required)
organization.abbreviation: The commonly used acronym or short form of the organization’s name (e.g., MIT for Massachusetts Institute of Technology, UN for United Nations) (required)
organization.website: The official website URL of the organization (e.g., https://www.mit.edu), providing a direct link to its online presence (optional)

subject.id: The official name of the academic subject, discipline, or field of study (e.g., Computer Science, Quantum Physics), serving as the unique identifier for this entity (required)
subject.about: A summary that outlines the scope of the subject, its core topics, and its relevance or importance in academia or industry, written in 1-2 sentences (required)

subject.id: The name of another subject that is closely related or interconnected (e.g., for 'Machine Learning', a related subject might be 'Artificial Intelligence') (required if subject is included)

concept.id: The official or commonly accepted name of the concept (e.g., 'Neural Networks', 'Quantum Entanglement'), used as the unique identifier for this entity (required)
concept.definition: A precise and concise explanation of what the concept means, written in 1-2 sentences for clarity and brevity (required)

subject.id: The name of the subject area to which this concept belongs (e.g., 'Machine Learning' for 'Neural Networks') (required if subject is included)

concept.id: The name of another concept that is directly related or often discussed in conjunction with this concept (e.g., 'Deep Learning' for 'Neural Networks') (required if concept is included)
